end.line: Quillon for Verity Health’s legal team

vo: Verity Health's legal team reviews about fifteen hundred data-sharing agreements across thirty hospitals. Here is that work in Quillon.
Your privacy positions are kept in one playbook, learned from closed agreements and reviewed by your team.
When a clinician needs a yes or no, ask one question across the whole agreement set, and Quillon reads them all.
And in Word, each new data-sharing agreement is redlined to those same privacy positions.
Rahul will walk your team through it on Friday the thirteenth.
